description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenClaw configuration file handling, including tests for environment overrides, URL parsing, config saving, and audit logging.

classes.name: OpenClawConfigFileTests
classes.description: Test suite for OpenClaw configuration file functionalities, including environment handling, URL parsing, and audit logging.

methods.name: makeConfigOverridePath
methods.description: Creates a temporary file path for configuration override tests.

methods.name: config path respects env override
methods.description: Tests that the configuration path respects environment variable overrides.

methods.name: remote gateway port parses and matches host
methods.description: Tests that the remote gateway URL is parsed correctly and matching host queries return expected ports.

methods.name: set remote gateway url preserves scheme
methods.description: Tests that setting a new remote gateway URL preserves the URL scheme.

methods.name: clear remote gateway url removes only url field
methods.description: Ensures that clearing the remote gateway URL only removes the URL field, preserving other data.

methods.name: state dir override sets config path
methods.description: Verifies that setting the state directory environment variable updates the config path accordingly.

methods.name: save dict appends config audit log
methods.description: Checks that saving a config dictionary creates an audit log entry with proper metadata.

methods.name: load dict audits suspicious out-of-band clobbers
methods.description: Ensures that suspicious changes to the config are detected and audited appropriately, including associated backup preservation.
